title: Decoding a work action after encoding
statement: For every optional work-tape write $w$, head movement $m\in\{-1,0,1\}$, and bit string $x$, the work-action reader applied to the encoding of $w$ followed by the encoding of $m$, and then by $x$, succeeds and returns the pair $(w,m)$ and suffix $x$.
